title: Encoded PowerShell observed on finance workstation
description: Defender detected powershell.exe launched with -enc by WIN-FIN-22. The process attempted a connection to 198.51.100.10. Validate the process tree and approved administration activity.

title: Repeated failed sign-ins followed by successful login
description: Account alex.chen@example.test had 14 failed sign-in attempts from 203.0.113.77 before a successful login. Review MFA and conditional access activity for possible password spray or valid account use.

title: Suspicious email with credential harvest link
description: A suspicious email delivered to procurement referenced https://signin-check.example.test/login. The message requested a credential refresh and has been held for analyst review.
